17 | Initiative VIII | caster | 1 rnd | self | U
18 | Mighty Strike II | 1 weapon | 1 rnd | touch | F
19 | Elemental Strike II | 1 weapon | 1 rnd | touch | E
20 | Chivalrous Blow III | 1 weapon | 1 rnd | touch | F
25 | Elemental Strike III | 1 weapon | 1 rnd | touch | E
30 | Chivalrous Blow IV | 1 weapon | 1 rnd | touch | F
50 | Nemesis Weapon | 1 weapon | 1 rnd/lvl | touch | E

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster enchants a melee weapon which is to become his “Personal Weapon.” This
spell grants the weapon a special bonus equal to +1 per level of the caster to
any attacks made with this weapon. The cost to cast this spell is equal to the
level of the caster. If the caster gains a level and he wishes the bonus to be
increased, he must recast this spell. The weapon only gains its bonus in the
hands of its owner. The special bonus is cumulative with any non-magical
bonuses the weapon may possess (material, construction, and/or quality) but
not with magical enhancements such as Bladerunes.
@@ 2
Caster adds 2 to his initiative roll next round.
@@ 3
The caster gains a surer grip on any weapon wielded during the spell duration,
lowering its fumble range by 1 (to a minimum of 1).
@@ 4
The caster’s Personal Weapon leaps into his hand, negating any penalties for
drawing a weapon.
@@ 5
Caster “ties” his Personal Weapon to himself. The fumble range of the weapon
will be raised by +1 per level of the caster for anyone other than the caster
who attempts to wield the weapon in combat. If the caster gains in level, and
he wishes the penalty to be increased as well, he must recast this spell.
@@ 6
Allows caster’s Personal Weapon to cut wood as well as an axe, break stone as
well as a mattock, or dig earth as well as a spade (must be designated at time
of casting).
@@ 7
Caster adds 4 to his initiative roll next round.
@@ 8
If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as
this spell is cast and is successful in delivering concussion hit damage to
his opponent, the amount of concussion hit damage will be doubled.
@@ 9
The caster gains a surer grip on any weapon wielded during the spell duration,
lowering its fumble range by 2 (to a minimum of 1).
@@ 10
If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as
this spell is cast, any critical strike will be treated as “Magic” for the
purposes of resolution (note that this is usually only applicable against
Large and Super Large creatures).
@@ 11
Caster adds 6 to his initiative roll next round.
@@ 12
If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as
this spell is cast, and that attack delivers a critical strike to the
opponent, an additional elemental critical (using the same roll) of two levels
less in severity will be delivered. Thus an ‘E’ critical strike will yield an
additional ‘C’ strike, a ‘D’ will yield an additional ‘B’, a ‘C’ will yield an
additional ‘A’ critical, and ‘A’ and ‘B’ criticals will yield no extra
critical. The type of elemental critical must be chosen at time of casting and
may only be one of the following: Heat, Cold, Electricity or Impact (Mana and
Void criticals from Arcane Companion may not be chosen).
@@ 13
The caster’s Personal Weapon will fly through the air to his outstretched hand
at a rate of 100' per round. Suitable barriers (with no openings that the
weapon can physically fit through) will cause this spell to fail (e.g., the
caster is in a windowless cell with a closed door).
@@ 14
For the duration of this spell, the caster’s Personal Weapon cannot be broken
normally (i.e., is not subject to the normal breakage rules). In addition, the
Personal Weapon receives an additional RR (at the level of the caster) against
criticals, spells and Weaponslaying items which break weapons.
@@ 15
If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as
this spell is cast, any critical strike will be treated as “Mithril” for the
purposes of resolution (note that this is usually only applicable against
Large and Super Large creatures).
@@ 16
The caster gains a surer grip on any weapon wielded during the spell duration,
lowering its fumble range by 6 (to a minimum of 1).
@@ 17
Caster adds 8 to his initiative roll next round.
@@ 18
If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as
this spell is cast and is successful in delivering concussion hit damage to
his opponent, the amount of concussion hit damage will be tripled.
@@ 19
As Elemental Strike I, except the critical is only one less in severity.
@@ 20
If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as
this spell is cast, any critical strike will be treated as “Holy” for the
purposes of resolution (note that this is usually only applicable against
Large and Super Large creatures).
@@ 25
As Elemental Strike I, except the critical is of equal severity.
@@ 30
If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as
this spell is cast, any critical strike will be treated as “Slaying” for the
purposes of resolution (the creature type must be chosen at time of casting;
note that this is usually only applicable against Large and Super Large
creatures).
@@ 50
As any one of the Mighty Strike, Elemental Strike, or Chivalrous Blow spells
per round (they may change each round).
